title_lines: GILGIT-BALTISTAN ELECTION 2026 · REVISION 4.3 PREDICTION SUMMARY (6 June 2026)

POST-REV-4.2 GROUND RE-CHECK BY PPP TEAM AI. THE FOUR-STAGE PIPELINE OVERTURNS GBA-5 NAGAR-II FROM MWM (RIAZ AKBER) TO PPP (ZULFIQAR ALI MURAD). PPP RETURNS TO 13 SEATS AND CLEARS THE 13/24 BARE MAJORITY THRESHOLD ON ITS OWN; MWM DROPS TO ONE SEAT (MAISAM KAZIM AT GBA-8, THE BLOC'S CM NOMINEE).
Election Date: 7 June 2026 (GBA-24 polling separately scheduled per ECGB notification).

party_projection.driver: Resurgence across Gilgit, Nagar, Hunza, Baltistan, Astore and Ghizer, plus Skardu-I via Syed Tauqeer Mehdi Shah (Rev 4.1 add) and Nagar-II via Zulfiqar Ali Murad (Rev 4.3 add). Deep organisational network, Bilawal-Aseefa roadshow impact, and the consolidation of Shia and progressive votes. Rev 4.2 ground re-check moves Ghanche-III out of the PPP column to an Independent (Dr Asad Shafiq) backed by PML-N; Rev 4.3 moves Nagar-II out of the MWM column into PPP.

Targeted strongholds in Gilgit-III, Skardu-IV (Rev 4.1: Wazir Hassan, replacing the earlier Skardu-I projection) and Ghizer-II. Federal alignment advantage in Sunni-leaning urban seats. PML-N also backs two Independents (Seth Anwar in Ghanche-II, Dr Asad Shafiq in Ghanche-III) where it is not fielding its own ticket-holder.

Maisam Kazim (GBA-8 Skardu-II) is the bloc's appointed Chief Minister nominee and remains MWM's sole projected seat after the Rev 4.3 ground re-check moves Nagar-II out of the MWM column to PPP (Zulfiqar Ali Murad).
Incumbent CM Gulbar Khan retains Diamer-IV; party flips in Astore-II and Diamer-II as PML-N candidates switch to IPP.
Islami Tehreek Pakistan retains Skardu-V (Amjad Zadi). Rev 4.1 ground re-check moves Skardu-IV out of the ITP column and into PML-N.

Diamer-I personal vote (M. Dilpazir), Ghanche-II PML-N-backed Independent (Seth Anwar), and Ghanche-III PML-N-backed Independent (Dr Asad Shafiq, Rev 4.2 add). Both Ghanche Independents are aligned with PML-N which has not fielded its own ticket-holders in those seats.

critical_flips.reason: Dr. Muhammad Iqbal flips Gilgit-III for PML-N versus the Rev 3.0 projection of an Aftab Haider PPP win. MWM runner-up indicates Shia bloc presence.

Rev 4.3 override. PPP takes Nagar-II via ticket-holder Zulfiqar Ali Murad. Survey re-check, regression refit on biraderi + prior-vote-share features, six-pillar rubric and three-of-five LLM jury all converge on PPP. The Rev 4.0 / 4.1 / 4.2 MWM call (Riaz Akber) is retired; the Rev 3.0 PTI-backed proxy framing remains retired.

Rev 4.1 override. PPP retakes Skardu-I via Syed Tauqeer Mehdi Shah, son of former GB CM Syed Mehdi Shah who held the seat in 2009. Survey re-check, regression refit (dynastic-continuity + prior-margin features), six-pillar rubric and three-of-five LLM jury all converge on PPP. The Rev 4.0 PML-N call (Haji Akbar Taban) is retired.
Fida M Nashad takes Skardu-III for PPP. The Rev 3.0 JUI-F projection (Wazir Saleem) collapses; JUI-F now wins zero seats.

Rev 4.1 override. PML-N takes Skardu-IV via Wazir Hassan and the Wazir biraderi network. Survey re-check, regression refit on structural-alignment + biraderi features, six-pillar rubric and three-of-five LLM jury all converge on PML-N. The Rev 4.0 ITP call (Wazir Ejaz Hussain) is retired.
ITP holds Skardu-V via Amjad Zadi. Now the bloc's only seat after the Rev 4.1 Skardu-IV reversal.
Shamsul Haq Lone holds Astore-II but switches from PML-N to IPP. Marks IPP's first general-seat win in this revision.
Atiqullah delivers Diamer-II to IPP. Confirms IPP's three-seat foothold.
Muhammad Naseem consolidates Diamer-III for PPP. JUI-F third indicates residual religious vote.
Outgoing CM Gulbar Khan retains Diamer-IV for IPP. Rev 3.0 had predicted a PML-N flip; survey reverses that call.
Abdul Jahan delivers Ghizer-II to PML-N. PTI proxy vote concentrates at third position only.

Rev 4.2 override. Dr Asad Shafiq takes Ghanche-III as an Independent backed by PML-N (which is not fielding its own ticket-holder here). Survey re-check, regression refit on biraderi + structural-alignment features, six-pillar rubric and three-of-five LLM jury all converge on the Independent call. The Rev 4.1 PPP projection (M. Ismail) is retired. GBA-24 polling date subject to ECGB revision.

government_formation_scenarios.label: PPP Bare Majority (75 percent)
government_formation_scenarios.description: PPP (13) reaches the bare 13/24 general-seat threshold on its own after the Rev 4.3 Nagar-II flip. The party can govern without a coalition partner, though it will almost certainly recruit MWM (Maisam Kazim, the CM-rank ally) or one Independent to widen the cushion against post-poll defections. Most likely Chief Minister: PPP.

government_formation_scenarios.label: Cross-Bench Coalition (15 percent)
government_formation_scenarios.description: PML-N (3) + IPP (3) + ITP (1) + the two PML-N-backed Independents (Seth Anwar in Ghanche-II, Dr Asad Shafiq in Ghanche-III) = 9 seats. Falls well short of a majority and cannot block a PPP-led government even with MWM in tow. Path to power requires splitting PPP loyalists in a horse-trading round.

government_formation_scenarios.label: Hung Assembly (10 percent)
government_formation_scenarios.description: No coalition consolidates cleanly. Reserved-seat allocation and post-poll defections become decisive. CM selection deferred to the federal arbitration round.

gba24_delay_note: GBA-24 (Ghanche-III) polling note: ECGB scheduling subject to revision.
